thread:
Katie (Marketing): Heads up — locking down the release announce for Wed 11am PT. Need final changelog link, docs URL, canary window, benchmark numbers for the blog + a webinar signup link. Can eng freeze rollouts at 10:30 PT so messaging matches production? :rocket:

Leo (Engineering): We can do a short freeze window. Planning a canary 10:35–10:50 PT, then full ramp at 11:05 PT. I'll post the changelog commit once the release tag is cut. Can you confirm the exact announcement time (11:00 vs 11:30)?

Katie (Marketing): 11:00 PT is ideal for sync with social timing. Webinar at 12:00 PT same day (30m + 15m Q&A). Need presenters and a short demo.

Olivia (Docs): Docs PR is here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/412 — requesting freeze on doc edits by Tue 6pm PT so I can merge and produce the canonical link. Also need the model version string for the "released in" callout.

Jamal (Product): Benchmark narrative: we want p50/p95/p99 latency and cost-per-1k-tokens for the default config and a quantized variant. QA to sanity-check numbers. The blog will need a one-sentence takeaway for the hero box.

QA Bot: CI benchmark summary: p50=118ms, p95=260ms, p99=430ms, cost=$0.55 per 1k tokens (default); quantized: p50=140ms, p99=520ms, cost=$0.18 per 1k. Full report: https://ci.redwood/bench/2957990123

Katie (Marketing): Great — @Olivia can you pull the p99/default cost into the blog intro? I'll craft the hero takeaway once we finalize wording (tentative: "Redwood lowers inference cost by ~60% with production quantization while keeping latency suitable for conversational apps").

Leo (Engineering): Changelog posted: https://github.com/redwood/changelog/commit/9f3a2b7 — tag v2026.03.11-rc1. Freezing rollout now per request. Will post a short runtime demo snippet for the webinar.

Olivia (Docs): Merged the PR and published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-11 — pinned the specific model and runtime notes.

Katie (Marketing): Inbound routing: Sales asked for a CS triage tag for demo requests and to route enterprise leads to the AE queue. Please add utm_campaign=launch_wave1 on the signup form. Olivia, can you add the hidden field and share the final signup link?

Olivia (Docs): Done — signup link: https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_campaign=launch_wave1. I added a hidden field and a mapping to the CRM for 'AE queue' when company size >50.

Jamal (Product): Webinar outline: 5m welcome, 10m benchmarks & cost story, 10m runtime demo, 5m roadmap + Q&A. Who's on demo? Leo?

Leo (Engineering): Yup I can do the runtime/demo portion. Will prepare a 2-min KV-cache demo with trace screenshots.

Katie (Marketing): I'll draft the announcement and the 3 social cards (hero stat, micro-benchmark, webinar CTA). Sharing draft in #marketing-drafts by EOD — please review by Tue 9pm PT.

QA Bot: Regression check passed for release tag v2026.03.11-rc1 — no perf regressions detected relative to baseline.

Katie (Marketing): Quick checklist: 1) changelog link (posted) 2) docs link (posted) 3) benchmark numbers (QA confirmed) 4) webinar link (posted) 5) freeze window (eng confirmed). If everyone can ack here, I'll schedule the announce and queue the press/social posts. :white_check_mark:

Leo (Engineering): ack

Olivia (Docs): ack

Jamal (Product): ack

Katie (Marketing): Thanks — I'll move to publish and share final assets here once queued. If anything slips, flag ASAP in this thread.
